gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-cantarell: Comic Relief hits with bold, commanding letters whose strokes never swell or thin, and whose bowls stay open on one side. Cantarell follows with c shapes whose tips pull well apart and arches that match their stems, which makes a long passage feel approachable.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-chiron-hei-hk: Strokes of one uniform width, with bowls that stay open, make Comic Relief unmistakable. Chiron Hei HK sits below with a wide c like a bracelet pulled apart, so a long passage reads in a modern, professional way.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-didact-gothic: Comic Relief is bold and commanding, its strokes showing no difference between upright and sideways, and its bowls left open on a side. Didact Gothic carries a modern read that never snags on a closed-up bowl, every stroke holding the same visual weight over a long passage.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-dotgothic16: Comic Relief brings bold, commanding letters with bowls that stay open on a side and strokes that never thicken or thin. DotGothic16 offers wide channels into each counter and a tube-like thickness through every bend, which is the pair's strongest card.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-encode-sans-sc: Encode Sans SC brings shallow terminal curls and a wide gap, professional and neutral in tone. Comic Relief takes the headline spot with constant-width lines and bowls open on one side, so the plain sans below it gives the page a steady, quiet floor.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-exo: Curves and stems moving in lockstep give Comic Relief its bold, commanding look, with bowls left open on one side. And Exo, approachable and clean, has wide gaps that keep tiny sizes crisp, so it can go quite small beneath that heading.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-fahkwang: Comic Relief draws its curves as thick as its straight stems, bold and commanding, with bowls that stay open on one side. Fahkwang can go smaller, its faint nib-pressure texture holding up.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-gantari: Comic Relief is the loud one, bold and commanding, with strokes that ignore any thick-thin shift and bowls that stay open. But Gantari does the quiet work, a wire-bent look across each word and wide c apertures that feel approachable.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-google-sans: Loud, round and unshaded: that is Comic Relief, bold and commanding, with strokes that never shift in thickness. And Google Sans handles the steady work, its terminals pulled well back and its curves flowing without any thick-thin shift.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-google-sans-flex: Comic Relief is bold and commanding, its lines unshaded and its bowls open on one side. And Google Sans Flex does the quieter job, with stroke ends that look cut from the same ribbon and each curve ending in a clean gap.
